memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder.
Patient reports persistent worry, restlessness, fatigue, difficulty concentrating for over six months, associated muscle tension and sleep disturbance. Denies panic attacks. On exam appears tense, mild tremor of hands, vitals normal. Smoking status: never smoker. GAD-7 score 14 (moderate).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Escitalopram 5 mg orally once daily
Buspirone 5 mg orally twice daily

memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder.
Patient reports reduced worry, improved sleep, occasional mild tension. Escitalopram well tolerated, no side effects. Buspirone causes mild dizziness occasionally. On exam calm, vitals normal. Smoking status: never smoker. GAD-7 score 9 (mild).
